gate.criterion: within-stale dominates (pooled CI lower bound >= 0.70) in >=2 program-verifiable scenarios
gate.reading_if_pass: within-stale dominates (pooled CI lower bound >= 0.70) in >=2 program-verifiable scenarios -> the stale-binding error signature replicates on independent real dialogue; proceed to K2.
gate.reading_if_dissociation: IF stale dominates but clean DP does not -> real IF-vs-DP dissociation; proceed to K2/K3 to explain the contrast.
gate.reading_if_fail: Otherwise -> report the boundary honestly (the synthetic signature is partly setup-specific / real-world failure is more heterogeneous).
